'''Antin Fessiq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Fessiq became a [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] in the Imperial Military and during the Galactic Civil War, ordered the troops under his command to destroy the village [[Actyallu]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Fessiq claimed that the villagers were aiding the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], when in fact they were innocent. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] Fessiq featured in a vision that was experienced by [[Garek Tolas]], a former Imperial soldier who had served under Fessiq, in the [[Temple of Pain]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]].
